{{verse|chapter=2|verse=16}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Martyrdō of the holy ''Innocents'', who{{ls}}e holy day is kept the 28 of Decembre.}}Then Herod perceauing that he vvas deluded by the Sages, Was exceding angrie: and {{ls}}ending {{sup|‖}} murdered al the men children that vvere in Bethlehem, & in al the borders therof, from tvvo yere old & vnder, according to the time vvhich he had diligently {{ls}}ought out of the Sages. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=17}} Then was fulfilled that vvhich vvas {{ls}}poken by Ieremie the Prophet {{ls}}aying, {{verse|chapter=2|verse=18}} ''A voice in Rama vvas heard, crying out & much vvayling: Rachel bevvayling her children, & vvould not be comforted, becau{{ls}}e they are not''.⊣ {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Iere. 31, 15.''}}

{{verse|chapter=2|verse=19}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Go{{ls}}pel on Twelfth eue.}}But vvhen Herod vvas dead, behold an Angel of our Lord appeared in {{ls}}leepe to Io{{ls}}eph in Aegypt, {{verse|chapter=2|verse=20}} {{ls}}aying, Ari{{ls}}e, and take the childe & his mother, & goe into the land of I{{ls}}rael. for they are dead that {{ls}}ought the life of the childe. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=21}} Who aro{{ls}}e, & tooke the childe & his mother, and came into the land of I{{ls}}rael. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=22}} But hearing that Archelaus reigned in Ievvrie for Herod his father, he feared to goe thither: and being vvarned in {{ls}}leepe retyred into the quarters of Galilee. {{verse|chapter=2|verse=23}} And coming he dwelt in a citie called Nazareth: that it might be fulfilled vvhich vvas {{ls}}ayd by the Prophetes: That he {{ls}}hal be called a Nazarite.
